title: Selling transfer-taxed tokens

options.name: Keep current behaviour: private V2 and partial sells use the non-fee-on-transfer router call; V3 has no taxed-token path
options.risk: Taxed V2 tokens always exit on the public fallback and never take partial profit; taxed V3 tokens cannot exit (AUD-EXIT-006, AUD-EXIT-007).

options.name: Use swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens on every V2 sell
options.behavior_impact: Taxed V2 tokens sell privately and partials work.
options.risk: The supporting variant does not return amounts; receipt decoding must not rely on it.

options.name: Additionally refuse to buy taxed tokens on V3 (or route their exit through a V2 pool)
options.behavior_impact: No V3 position that cannot be sold.

recommendation: supporting-variant together with refuse-taxed-v3, after a Phase 23 fork check on a real taxed token.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). Capital-relevant, but the linked findings are S2 or lower, so the default is safe to rest on until then.
behavior_impact: Decides whether taxed tokens can be sold privately and at all on V3.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
